source.check: returned unopposed: 'Glenarm - No nomination received. Retiring member - Mr. W. J. F. Donald thus retains his seat' (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1949)

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 17 May 1949, withdrawals to 18 May, and polling on Thursday 2 June 1949 ('POLLING took place yesterday', Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949, p. 5). Two divisions were contested, Portrush and Ballycastle; the other 21 members were returned unopposed. No party labels were printed. No nomination was received; the retiring member retained the seat. Returned unopposed.
